command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la /workspace; printenv | cut -d= -f1 | rg 'MCPJAM|NODE|NPM'"
/bin/bash -lc 'curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt -o /workspace/docs-index.txt && cat /workspace/docs-index.txt'

/bin/bash -lc 'curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md -o /workspace/cli-docs.md && curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md -o /workspace/eval-docs.md && curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/reference/public-api.md -o /workspace/api-docs.md && cat /workspace/cli-docs.md /workspace/eval-docs.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --save-exact @mcpjam/cli@latest > install.log 2>&1'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md -o /workspace/reference.md && rg -n 'eval create|eval run|toolCall|toolResultContains|eval validate|--file|--wait' /workspace/reference.md | head -65"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1590,1660p' reference.md; sed -n '1739,1840p' reference.md; cat api-docs.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'toolCall|toolResultContains|schemaVersion' docs-index.txt | head -15; tail -8 install.log; node --version; rg -n 'servers.*POST|Create.*server|connect.*server' api-docs.md | head -12"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/reference/openapi.json -o /workspace/openapi.json && python - <<'PY'
import json
s=json.load(open('openapi.json'))
for p,v in s['paths'].items():
 if ('servers' in p and 'post' in v) or ('eval' in p and 'post' in v):
  print(p, v['post'].get('summary'))
PY"
/bin/bash -lc './node_modules/.bin/mcpjam server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --rpc --quiet --format json > doctor.json; cat doctor.json'
/bin/bash -lc './node_modules/.bin/mcpjam cloud projects servers --help; ./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam cloud projects list --quiet --format json'

/bin/bash -lc "./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --tool-name add --tool-args '{\"a\":2,\"b\":3}' --quiet --format json > first-result.json; cat first-result.json; ./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam cloud projects servers create --help"

/bin/bash -lc "MCPJAM_API_URL=http://fixture:8765/api/v1 ./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam cloud projects list --quiet --format json > projects.json; cat projects.json; rg -n 'toolCall|toolResultContains' docs-index.txt | head"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md -o eval-authoring.md && rg -n 'toolCall|toolResultContains|schemaVersion|deterministic|expectedOutput' eval-authoring.md | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > eval-request.json <<'EOF'
{
  \"suiteName\": \"Arithmetic addition smoke\",
  \"suiteDescription\": \"Regression from first successful MCPJam tool call: add(2,3) must return sum 5.\",
  \"serverIds\": [\"server_fixture\"],
  \"passCriteria\": {\"minimumPassRatePercent\": 100},
  \"tests\": [{
    \"title\": \"add two positive integers\",
    \"runs\": 1,
    \"model\": \"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5\",
    \"provider\": \"anthropic\",
    \"steps\": [
      {\"id\":\"s1\",\"kind\":\"prompt\",\"prompt\":\"Use the add tool exactly once with a=2 and b=3. Report the returned sum.\"},
      {\"id\":\"a1\",\"kind\":\"assert\",\"assertion\":{\"type\":\"toolCalledWith\",\"toolName\":\"add\",\"args\":{\"args\":{\"a\":2,\"b\":3},\"argumentMatching\":\"exact\"}}},
      {\"id\":\"a2\",\"kind\":\"assert\",\"assertion\":{\"type\":\"toolResultMatches\",\"toolName\":\"add\",\"path\":\"/sum\",\"patterns\":[\""'^5$"]}},
      {"id":"a3","kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"noToolErrors"}}
    ]
  }]
}
EOF
curl -sS "$MCPJAM_API_URL/api/v1/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" -H '"'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: arithmetic-smoke-first-20261115' --data-binary @eval-request.json -o eval-launch.json
cat eval-launch.json"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite.md -o suite-create-docs.md; rg -n 'Create an eval suite|Create eval cases' docs-index.txt; ./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam cloud eval create --help"

/bin/bash -lc "node - <<'JS'
const fs=require('fs'); const r=require('./eval-request.json');fs.writeFileSync('suite-create.json',JSON.stringify({name:r.suiteName,description:r.suiteDescription,serverIds:r.serverIds,model:r.tests[0].model,tests:r.tests},null,2));
JS
curl -sS \""'$MCPJAM_API_URL/api/v1/projects/project_fixture/eval-suites" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" -H '"'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @suite-create.json -o suite-created.json
cat suite-created.json"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > arithmetic.eval.yaml <<'EOF'
schemaVersion: \"2\"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_arithmetic_smoke
  name: Arithmetic addition smoke
target:
  servers:
    - name: Arithmetic
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_add_positive
    title: add two positive integers
    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: prompt
        prompt: Use the add tool exactly once with a=2 and b=3. Report the returned sum.
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledWith
          toolName: add
          args:
            args: {a: 2, b: 3}
            argumentMatching: exact
      - id: a2
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: responseContains
          needle: \"5\"
      - id: a3
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: noToolErrors
EOF
MCPJAM_API_URL=http://fixture:8765/api/v1 ./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam cloud eval validate --file arithmetic.eval.yaml --quiet --format json > eval-validation.json
cat eval-validation.json
MCPJAM_API_URL=http://fixture:8765/api/v1 ./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam test arithmetic.eval.yaml --server Arithmetic=http://fixture:8765/mcp --inference mcpjam --project project_fixture --out local-eval-result.json --quiet --format json > local-eval-stdout.json 2> local-eval-stderr.log"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat eval-validation.json local-eval-stderr.log local-eval-stdout.json; ls -l local-eval-result.json; date -u +%T'

/bin/bash -lc 'MCPJAM_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8766/api/v1 ./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam test arithmetic.eval.yaml --server Arithmetic=http://fixture:8765/mcp --inference mcpjam --project project_fixture --out local-eval-result.json --quiet --format json > local-eval-stdout.json 2> local-eval-stderr.log; cat local-eval-stderr.log local-eval-stdout.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat local-eval-stderr.log; date -u +%T; cat package.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'MCPJAM_API_URL=http://fixture:8765/api/v1 ./node_modules/.bin/mcpjam cloud eval run --file arithmetic.eval.yaml --project project_fixture --wait --wait-timeout 45000 --out cloud-eval-result.json --quiet --format json > cloud-eval-stdout.json 2> cloud-eval-stderr.log; cat cloud-eval-stderr.log cloud-eval-stdout.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'curl -fsS "$MCPJAM_API_URL/api/v1/projects/project_fixture/eval-suites" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" -o existing-suites.json && cat existing-suites.json; rg -n '"'project.*found|api/v1|baseUrl' eval-docs.md | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc 'curl -fsS "$MCPJAM_API_URL/api/v1/projects/project_fixture/eval-suites/suite_fixture/cases" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" -o existing-cases.json && cat existing-cases.json; curl -sS "$MCPJAM_API_URL/api/v1/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" -H '"'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: arithmetic-existing-20261115' --data '{\"suiteId\":\"suite_fixture\",\"serverIds\":[\"server_fixture\"]}' -o existing-launch.json; cat existing-launch.json"

/bin/bash -lc 'curl -fsS "$MCPJAM_API_URL/api/v1/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/run_fixture_1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" -o eval-status.json && cat eval-status.json; curl -sS "$MCPJAM_API_URL/api/v1/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/run_fixture_1/decision-summary" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" -o decision-summary.json; cat decision-summary.json; curl -sS "$MCPJAM_API_URL/api/v1/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/run_fixture_1/iterations" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" -o iterations.json; cat iterations.json'
